title: 槲寄生：针对推测解码的隐蔽加速崩溃攻击
summary: 本文发现模型推测解码中草稿模型与目标模型不匹配的机制漏洞，提出Mistletoe攻击。通过联合优化降低草稿接受率的退化目标和保持语义的约束目标，并引入零空间投影解决冲突，显著降低平均接受长度、崩溃加速比，同时保持输出质量。
summary_en: This paper identifies a mechanism-level vulnerability in model-based speculative decoding due to drafter-target mismatch, and proposes Mistletoe attack. It jointly optimizes a degradation objective to reduce draft acceptance and a semantic-preservation objective, using null-space projection to resolve conflicts, substantially reducing average accepted length and collapsing speedup while maintaining output quality.
